scientific limitations/integrity: The identity is for C^2 strictly convex bodies with everywhere positive Gauss curvature and for the source-proved limiting vertex laws of the inscribed volume and mean-width approximation problems. It quantifies separation of those probability laws but does not claim geometric stability in Hausdorff, Banach--Mazur, or affine distance. The curvature-moment formula, equality case, similarity invariance, and integrated log-curvature variance representation are proved analytically; the checker only replays algebraic coefficients and scaling.
title: Exact Hellinger curvature gap for optimal polytope vertex laws
